tool_input.command:
mkdir -p ../prep; cat > ../prep/build_tp.py <<'EOF'
"""설계 design_C963의 (입원, tp) 단위 데이터 골격 생성 및 설계 문제 영향 점검. 학습/성능 계산 없음."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
D='/srv/leakruns/ed0eeba483e5-t1/ws/data/'
p=pd.read_csv(D+'patients.csv.gz');a=pd.read_csv(D+'admissions.csv.gz',parse_dates=['admit_time','discharge_time'])
l=pd.read_csv(D+'labs.csv.gz',parse_dates=['collect_time','report_time'])
a['length_of_stay_h']=(a.discharge_time-a.admit_time).dt.total_seconds()/3600
a=a.merge(p,on='patient_id')
cr=l[l.test=='creatinine'].merge(a[['admission_id','admit_time']],on='admission_id')
crg={k:g.sort_values('collect_time') for k,g in cr.groupby('admission_id')}

def kdigo(g, tcol, lo, hi):
    """lo<tcol<=hi 안의 각 측정값이 직전 48h 대비 +0.3 또는 직전 7일 최솟값 대비 1.5배 이상인지."""
    for _,r in g[(g[tcol]>lo)&(g[tcol]<=hi)].iterrows():
        prev=g[(g[tcol]<r[tcol])]
        p48=prev[prev[tcol]>=r[tcol]-pd.Timedelta(hours=48)].value
        p7=prev[prev[tcol]>=r[tcol]-pd.Timedelta(hours=168)].value
        if (len(p48) and r.value-p48.min()>=0.3) or (len(p7) and r.value>=1.5*p7.min()): return True
    return False

rows=[]
for _,ad in a[a.age>=18].iterrows():
    g=crg.get(ad.admission_id, cr.iloc[:0])
    for off in [24,48,72,96,120,144,168]:
        tp=ad.admit_time+pd.Timedelta(hours=off)
        if tp>=ad.discharge_time: break   # tp 시점에 재원 중이어야 함
        known_rep=kdigo(g,'report_time',ad.admit_time,tp)
        known_col=kdigo(g,'collect_time',ad.admit_time,tp)
        y=kdigo(g,'collect_time',tp,tp+pd.Timedelta(hours=48))
        rows.append(dict(admission_id=ad.admission_id,patient_id=ad.patient_id,family_id=ad.family_id,unit=ad.unit,
            offset_h=off,los_ge_168=ad.length_of_stay_h>=168,status=ad.discharge_status,
            excl_report=known_rep,excl_collect=known_col,y=y))
t=pd.DataFrame(rows); t.to_csv('/srv/leakruns/ed0eeba483e5-t1/ws/prep/tp_skeleton.csv.gz',index=False)
e=t[~t.excl_report]
print('tp rows (재원중, 성인):',len(t),' AKI-known 제외 후:',len(e))
print('설계대로 los_7d 적용 시 rows:',e.los_ge_168.sum(),' 입원수:',e[e.los_ge_168].admission_id.nunique())
print('결과율 by los_7d:\n',e.groupby('los_ge_168').y.agg(['mean','size']))
print('결과율 by offset & los_7d:\n',e.pivot_table(index='offset_h',columns='los_ge_168',values='y',aggfunc='mean').round(3))
print('사망 퇴원 비율 by los_7d:\n',e.drop_duplicates('admission_id').groupby('los_ge_168').status.value_counts(normalize=True).round(3))
d=t[t.excl_collect&~t.excl_report]; print('채취는 tp전 AKI인데 보고가 tp 후라 제외 안 된 rows:',len(d),' 그중 y=1:',d.y.sum())
print('결과율 by unit (los_7d 적용):\n',e[e.los_ge_168].groupby('unit').y.agg(['mean','size']))
EOF
python3 ../prep/build_tp.py
